data=[]
for r in rows:
    data.append([c.value for c in r[:6]])
n=len(data)
to_delete=set()
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i==j: continue
        if data[i][0]==data[j][0] and data[i][5]==data[j][5]:
            if data[i][2]==data[j][3] or data[i][3]==data[j][2]:

                to_delete.add(j)
print('rows to delete (0-indexed):', sorted(to_delete))
for idx in sorted(to_delete, reverse=True):
    ws.delete_rows(idx+2)  # +2 because row1 header, idx is 0-based in data
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
